ours.label: ours_b256_cpu
ours.process_attribution_limit: Device-wide counters. Process lists sampled every 2 s can miss short-lived competitors; absence of another PID is not proof of exclusive execution.
ours.interpretation: GPU busy% is time activity; memory busy% is time device memory was read/written, not bandwidth saturation. Neither measures SM occupancy, FLOPs, MFU, or separate graphics/compute/copy-engine saturation. Polls can repeat the same hardware sampling window. Phase timings include telemetry overhead; use independent uninstrumented paired timings for FPS.
